environment_notes: Free 2.6.2 and Pro 2.6.2 active on mediaverse.local (Reign 8.0.7, BuddyPress off, WB Gamification active); Docker 8911 BuddyPress 14.5.2 + Reign. Debug log baseline 3757057 bytes; diff window archived to qa-artifacts/debug-log-2.6.2-2026-10-13T12:32:00Z.txt.
Scope: this pass fully walked X_2_6_2_focus and a sample of C/D/E; the remaining C/D/E rows are listed as untested, not passed. A and B skipped (live model site).

Seeding used UploadService::handle via WP-CLI (Smoke Gal A1-A4 as journey_owner, Smoke Cdn); storage driver on the model site is bunnycdn, so uploads reached the real CDN zone and the deleted files' edge copies still answer 200.

Temporary setting changes, all restored: mvs_allow_user_privacy '' -> '1' -> ''; Settings > Display Layout via the UI (original -> list -> dribbble -> flickr -> instagram -> flickr -> original) then mvs_thumbnail_style and mvs_layout_choice deleted (neither existed before), mvs_pro_feed_layout grid; page 'Smoke grid block' (id 426) created and deleted.

Docker changes: BuddyPress Groups component activated (rewrite flushed) for X7 then deactivated; groups 11-13, users smoke_peer/smoke_peer2, conversations 8-9 and all Smoke media deleted; Docker layout option reset. Passwords set to qa-pass-262 for admin, qa_member, qa_victim, qa_attacker (allowed by the brief). qa_friend's attacker-thread notifications were marked read by the X4 test. Conv 7 unpinned.
Fixture cleanup block run before and after; 0 Smoke/E2E rows, comments or notifications remain on either site.

Playwright MCP wrote page snapshots/console logs into the site-root .playwright-mcp folder (pre-existing practice); the smoke screenshots were moved to qa-artifacts/smoke-2.6.2/. Two tool calls hung for 30 minutes (browser_tabs close, new browser context); no data impact.

Pre-existing, not from this run: 40 failed mvs_cleanup_media_files, 9 mvs_cloud_sync_media and 2 mvs_cloud_repatriate_media Action Scheduler jobs from Oct 10-11 ('marked as failed after 300 seconds'), and 18 buddynext_mvs_media_activity jobs from Sep 19 with no callback.

Dark mode: Reign does not follow prefers-color-scheme and the plugin deliberately has no media-query dark mode (frontend.css line 462); dark was tested by setting Reign's [data-bx-mode=dark] + body.dark-scheme.

After the walk, these fixes landed and were checked separately (not re-walked): comment Save with unchanged text (200), Pro competition pages on the shared virtual-route list, import album privacy (Pro), Integrations screen claims. Release CI reruns on the final head.

failures.triage_note: Same drift as 2.6.1 still true: runbook rows no longer match shipped behaviour. Not product defects; update the runbook.
failures.actual: A2: 33 tables total (4 pro_ tables), not 36/13; /media/<slug>/ renders 200 with no 301 to /p/<id>; Settings has 12 sections; reaction/comment notifications are media_reaction/media_comment; bulk route needs media_ids (+privacy); Load More/lightbox selectors changed; the Display 'Layout' control saves mvs_thumbnail_style (mvs_layout_choice is only a transport); the runbook cannot be run on mediaverse.local for private-media rows unless mvs_allow_user_privacy is on.

failures.triage_note: Text comes from WB Gamification, not MediaVerse.
failures.actual: Toast reads 'Streak milestone! days Keep showing up' (number missing).

accepted_by_design.note: A video with no OpenAI key answers 503 'provider not configured' only after the type check; non-video answers 422 'videos only' first (the 2.6.2 contract).
With the Instagram layout the toolbar says '1 item' (tiles) while the profile header says '3 media' (items visible to the viewer); both are consistent with their own unit.
Refusal text 'This action is unavailable between you and this member.' deliberately does not say who blocked whom.
Unknown tag URL answers a theme 404 rather than an empty state; no fatal.
The second .mvs-lightbox on BuddyPress tabs is the intentional mvs-bp-lightbox-clone; the visible one is the clone.

accepted_by_design.triage_note: Opus re-verify: not a 2.6.2 regression. The lightbox has never had a Reply control (absent from v2.6.1 templates/partials/shared-ui-frame.php and view.js); replies come from REST/app or BuddyPress. Owner decision 13 Oct: ship 2.6.2, Reply + threaded replies planned for 2.7.0 (Basecamp 10399605789).
accepted_by_design.expected: Reply control in the lightbox comment list; replies shown threaded under the parent.
accepted_by_design.actual: No Reply button; a reply created with POST /media/{id}/comments {parent} is invisible in the lightbox list; delete prompt says 'Delete this comment and its reply?'.
